children: San Francisco-based Flam secures USD 40 million Series B led by QED Investors to expand AI models, patents and interactive content formats for global enterprise brands

San Francisco-headquartered AI interactive content company Flam has raised USD 40 million in a Series B funding round led by QED Investors, with participation from Claypond Capital, Australian Gulf Capital, the SRK Family Office, Martin Chavez, Venky Harinarayan and Olivier Pomel. Existing investors RTP Global and Dovetail also followed on in the round.

Founded in 2021 as a research lab, Flam introduced its first product to market in 2024 and has spent seven quarters scaling commercially, reaching more than 100 enterprise customers across the US, EU and APAC. The company, which holds 15-plus patents, will use the proceeds to expand AI research and development, grow its product suite and scale enterprise sales.

Flam builds content that responds to the viewer while streaming as fast as video, positioning itself as an AI interactive content company rather than a marketing-technology vendor. Its end-to-end stack spans generative models for content creation, a proprietary interactive format and a low-latency streaming infrastructure designed to run inside standard video and display placements.

The company’s product line includes Flicks, an interactive video format that changes based on what the viewer taps with effectively zero latency, enabled by a patented AI compression method that merges multiple variations of a single piece of content into one small file. It also offers Airboards, which stream high-fidelity 3D content onto a phone’s camera interface with no app download, and Visual agents, hyperreal AI characters built for conversation with response times under two seconds.

Flam works with more than 100 enterprises, including Google, Samsung, Netflix, Salesforce, McDonald’s, KFC, Diageo, State Farm, British American Tobacco, Asahi Breweries, Acer, LG, Hyundai, Volkswagen, Emirates, Reliance, SBI and HDFC.
All four major agency holding groups—WPP, Dentsu, Omnicom and Havas—are customers. Priority markets are the US, India, Japan, the UAE and Southeast Asia.

Shourya Agarwal, Founder and CEO of Flam, is a computer science graduate of BITS Pilani and a Forbes Asia 30 Under 30 awardee. Based in San Francisco, he started the company in 2021 on the conviction that every surface a person already looks at should be able to respond.

Flam also lists an advisor bench that includes former Meta ads chief Carolyn Everson; former Google agency partnerships director Jitendra Kumar; former McDonald’s/Petco CMO and current Wendy’s CMO Tariq Hassan; former Reddit CRO Mike Romoff; and ex-Technicolor and Warner Bros/Sony Pictures executives Tim Sarnoff and Vince Pizzica, among others.
